notices.support: The statute gives no wording for the form.
notices.summary_row: CID-approved residential disclosure form (the wording itself)

notices.title: State cancellation statement near the signature and duplicate NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form
notices.trigger: Door-to-door sale: consumer goods or services of $25 or more, solicited in person (including after an invitation by the buyer) with the agreement made away from the seller's place of business, and seller-initiated telephone sales
notices.format: Statement in bold face, minimum ten points, in immediate proximity to the buyer's signature space; NOTICE OF CANCELLATION in duplicate, attached and easily detachable, ten-point bold; in the language of the sales presentation; oral notice
notices.support: The official definition includes sales "in response to or following an invitation by the buyer".
notices.block: NMSA 1978, 57-12-21. Door-to-door sales; contracts; requirements; prohibitions
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole of 57-12-21 (seller prohibitions, refund duties, definitions and exclusions) around the statement and the NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form; printing it would put non-notice statute text in the customer's contract.
notices.summary_row: Door-to-door sales: contract statement, NOTICE OF CANCELLATION, oral notice, definitions

changes.new: Three business days (NMSA 57-12-21), on top of the federal rule

Door-to-door sales of consumer goods or services of $25 or more, including sales made after an invitation by the buyer, with the agreement made away from the seller's place of business; a requested visit to repair the buyer's personal property is excluded, not the house

Business day means any calendar day except Sunday and the listed holidays, so Saturday counts; for seller-initiated telephone sales the period does not begin until the buyer has been told of the right and given the notice copies
changes.support: "business day" means any calendar day except Sunday or the following business holidays

changes.new: CID license under CILA; handyman exemption up to $7,200 compensation a year with an annual declaration filed with the division
changes.support: Handyman exemption is confirmed at $7,200 a year with an annual declaration

unsure: NM-default: the CID-approved residential disclosure form was not obtained, so no wording is loaded; the statute requires it in writing on a division-approved form before work, signature or payment.
